title: Exploring Adversarial Robustness and Safety Alignment in Multilingual Multi-Modal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper conducts a systematic study of 'safety alignment' and 'multimodal safety' by benchmarking model responses to harmful instructions (e.g., hate speech, illegal acts, tax evasion, and self-harm) across 12 languages. This evaluation specifically measures the ethical guardrails and moral refusal behaviors of the models.
